filter_check.method: Qualitative scan of rejected groups; individual boxes not listed.
filter_check.magenta_single_track: Mostly away from the river and show no visible change. Supports rejecting single-track clusters as noise.
filter_check.cyan_water_or_off_corridor: Around Ingram, cyan boxes show water / flooding along the stream network. Suggests the 'existing water' group contains real flood signal there (water beyond normal channel or pool), so it should not be discarded wholesale.

summary.note: Precision only: boxes not flagged by the screen were not reviewed, so missed flood effects (recall) are unmeasured. All 9 flood-effect boxes lie on the Kerrville to Center Point reach (491,200-496,900 E); 3 of 4 no-change boxes lie on the Comfort reach or east of it, and one on the South Fork west of Hunt.

status: Exploratory visual review by one reviewer; not field-verified.
